name: Timers
author: brodgar
description: A countdown list built from hafen.ui()'s own controls: one window holding your timers and an Add button, a dialog asking for a name, hours and minutes, and a Start, Edit and delete button on every row. The list stays ordered by remaining time, ascending, so whatever fires next is at the top. Nothing here writes to the server, so there is no permission to grant; the timers live in an account-wide saved variable, and one that was running comes back still running. :timers opens and closes the list.
